reports.title: Teleflex Reports Third Quarter Financial Results and Full Year 2026 Outlook

lines: Increasing 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS from Continuing Operations Guidance Range to $7.50 to $7.75
On a GAAP basis, the Company reduced its full year 2026 revenue growth from continuing operations outlook to a range of 13.2% to 14.2%.
On a pro forma adjusted constant currency basis, the Company maintained its full year 2026 revenue growth from continuing operations outlook range of 3.5% to 4.5%.
The Company increased its full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share from continuing operations outlook to a range of $2.84 to $3.09.
The Company increased its full year 2026 adjusted diluted earnings per share from continuing operations outlook to a range of $7.50 to $7.75.
